authority.owner_authority: 2026-08-21 explicit DONE for one disposable C1 validator materialization and non-leakage probe
scope: exact top-level tarball and integrity installation
not_authorized: A, B, C, or D arm creation or execution
consumer worktree checkout, pull, edit, install, or branch change
C2, C3, or Route C work

source.materialization: git archive of the exact baseline into disposable sibling roles named baseline and candidate

execution_environment.network: enabled only for npm ci, exact tarball download, and transitive dependency installation; disabled for adapter, dry run, mutation run, and leakage scan

range_contract.deletion_only_policy: fail with NO_MUTATABLE_CHANGED_PRODUCTION_LINES rather than invent a target

pre_network_checks: framework HEAD contains this manifest and every committed input at its declared SHA-256 and byte length
the exact pre-run commit is pushed before materialization begins
consumer baseline commit and tree match this manifest
consumer worktree status is recorded before and after and must be byte-for-byte unchanged as a path/status inventory digest
materialization_steps: create a fresh disposable probe root outside the consumer worktree
git archive the exact baseline twice into sibling baseline and candidate directories
copy only the committed public probe fixture into candidate
run the committed adapter and require the exact expected range and exclusion lists
copy the committed Stryker config into a separate read-only probe-input mount
install_steps: run npm ci in candidate under the pinned image
download both exact tarball URLs to a disposable package directory
verify each tarball with sha512sum against sha512_hex
run npm install --no-save --package-lock=false using only the verified local tarballs
record npm ls for core, Vitest runner, and Vitest
procedure.dry_run: with C1_PROBE_DRY_RUN_ONLY=1 and the exact JSON range list in C1_PROBE_MUTATE_RANGES_JSON, run timeout 300s npx --no-install stryker run /probe-input/stryker.config.mjs
procedure.mutation_run: with C1_PROBE_DRY_RUN_ONLY=0 and the same exact inputs, run timeout 300s npx --no-install stryker run /probe-input/stryker.config.mjs
procedure.timeout_sentinel: run timeout 1s node -e setTimeout for 5 seconds and require exit 124 before interpreting a later 124 as timeout
procedure.resource_observation: record host wall time for install, dry run, and mutation run; enforce Docker CPU, memory, and PID limits; inspect OOMKilled and exit code

scan_surfaces: range adapter stdout, stderr, and JSON
Stryker mutation stdout, stderr, and JSON report
non_leakage.allowed_output_basis: only candidate-owned source/test paths, probe fixture names, generated mutants, execution diagnostics, and aggregate cost

classification.VALIDATOR_PROBE_PASSED: all six requested checks pass and total wall time is within the cost ceiling
classification.VALIDATOR_PROBE_FAILED: input, install, dry-run, range, timeout-classification, execution, or evidence binding fails without a denied leakage match
classification.VALIDATOR_LEAKAGE_BLOCKED: any scanned raw validator surface contains a denied hidden-information literal or receives a forbidden input
classification.VALIDATOR_COST_BLOCKED: execution succeeds functionally but exceeds the total wall-time ceiling or any declared resource limit

claim_ceiling: This probe may establish only bounded technical compatibility, diff-range behavior, failure classification, non-leakage for the scanned exact outputs, and observed cost under one disposable environment. It cannot establish validator effect, Skill effect, general non-leakage, Gate 1 readiness, preregistration, freeze, or any arm result.
